root_cause: A feature flag exposed the same guest-checkout NPE as PROD-4521. tenant-config-service v3.2.1 enabled the 'guest-checkout' flag for cohort B (Acme Corp included) at 07:12, 13 minutes before Acme's checkout failures began at 07:25. That puts Acme's users on the guest checkout path, which hits the known null customer.savedPaymentMethod bug at PaymentService.java:142. Ruled out: frontend v12.4.1 at 06:50 is close in time but only changed pricing-page copy (src/pages/pricing.tsx), which has nothing to do with the payment confirmation step and wouldn't be tenant-specific.

recommended_action: Needs human approval: (1) Page the CSM and on-call (P1, one tenant). (2) Fastest mitigation: disable the 'guest-checkout' flag for cohort B, or roll back tenant-config-service to v3.2.0 (rollback_available: true). That takes Acme off the broken path without waiting for the payment-service fix. (3) The permanent fix is the PROD-4521 line-142 null check. Keep the flag off until it ships. (4) Status line for the CSM before the CTO call: 'We've identified the cause: a feature rollout at 07:12 UTC put your tenant on a new checkout path with a known defect. We're reverting that rollout for your tenant now and will confirm when checkout is restored.'
